why: the sign of zero (design/signed-zero.md). Lane A's model holds no -0 input, as it holds no NaN (special-numbers.md): normalized (x against x === 0 ? 0 : x), magnitude (Math.abs(x) against x < 0 ? -x : x) and plus_zero (x + 0 against x) are proved on that model and differ only at x = -0, which lane B now draws (the fourth special value) and witnesses; check.mjs runs lane B first, so the verdict is WITNESS. A -0 an operation makes from the model's inputs makes an ordinary unit opaque, keyed by its source (signed-zero), or, inside the heap core, marks the world. doubled (x * 2 against x + x, equal on every double), positive and flipped (a negation under a test that n is nonzero: never -0) and untouched are proved.
